script.text: Слушай, если хочешь загипнотизировать кого-нибудь, ты тоже можешь сыграть эту мелодию на волшебной флейте!
script.instructions: Speak Russian as an expressive adult male cartoon duck. Keep the bright nasal, slightly raspy voice. Most important: use an unmistakable interdental and lateral lisp throughout. Place the tongue between the front teeth for Russian с and з; let air escape around the tongue for ш and ж, giving wet, spluttery, slushy sibilants. This is a sustained articulation pattern, not a higher pitch. Exaggerate the lisp while keeping every word understandable. Energetic theatrical delivery. Speak the provided sentence exactly once, with no introductions, added words or repetitions. Do not vocalize these instructions. Leave a short pause before and after the sentence.
